title.zh: EU cyber rules put crypto wallet makers on 24-hour reporting clock
title.en: EU cyber rules put crypto wallet makers on 24-hour reporting clock

current_state.zh: The EU's Cyber Resilience Act now requires crypto wallet providers to report actively exploited vulnerabilities within 24 hours and submit full notifications within 72 hours, with fines of up to $17.3 million for noncompliance.
current_state.en: The EU's Cyber Resilience Act now requires crypto wallet providers to report actively exploited vulnerabilities within 24 hours and submit full notifications within 72 hours, with fines of up to $17.3 million for noncompliance.
